target.title: fix(provider-runtime): treat HTTP 429 as retryable in provider operations
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) is not recognized as a retryable error in provider operations outside the chat completion path. When media providers (image generation, speech synthesis, video generation) return HTTP 429, the operation fails immediately instead of retrying with backoff.

Root cause: `isTransientProviderOperationError` in `src/provider-runtime/operation-retry.ts:154` checks only 500/502/503/504. Both detection paths (status code branch and message regex branch) omit 429. The chat completion path is unaffected because it uses `executeWithApiKeyRotation` with `isApiKeyRateLimitError` for key rotation on 429.

Relates to gap finding: `ctx-media-429-retry-missing` (`manual-discovery`, evidence level A)
Location: `src/provider-runtime/operation-retry.ts:154`

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `status === 429` to the status code branch and `429` to the message regex in `isTransientProviderOperationError`, so both detection paths cover 429. Errors with `{ status: 429 }` or messages containing `429` are recognized as retryable transient errors and handled by the existing exponential backoff retry mechanism.

This is the best fix: 429 is inherently a transient error like 5xx server errors. Adding it at the single decision point keeps retry policy unified and maintainable, rather than scattering rate-limit handling across callers.

## User Impact

Users of media providers (image generation, speech synthesis, video generation): previously, 429 rate limits caused immediate failure; after this fix, operations retry automatically with backoff per the provider retry configuration, improving success rates under API rate limiting. No effect on other provider operations.

## Evidence

- `pnpm test src/provider-runtime/operation-retry.test.ts` — 16 passed (including 2 new 429-specific test cases: one for structured `{ status: 429 }` error, one for unstructured error message containing `429`)
- `pnpm check:changed` — pending (CI)
- Autoreview: clean — no findings
- CI: pending

Behavior addressed: HTTP 429 detected as transient/recoverable for provider operation retry
Real environment tested: unit tests with mocked provider operation errors
Exact steps or command run after this patch: `pnpm test src/provider-runtime/operation-retry.test.ts`
Evidence after fix: 16/16 tests passed, including new cases that verify 429 is correctly classified as retryable
Observed result after fix: `{ status: 429 }` and error messages containing `429` are now matched by `isTransientProviderOperationError`
What was not tested: live provider endpoint with actual rate limiting (requires live credentials and triggering rate limits)
